input.quote: For the purpose of this Agreement, extended payment charges shall be computed at three hundred percent (300%) of the rate described in Subparagraph 7.8 on the day following the date payment on the bill was due.
input.rationale: Subparagraph 7.9 requires a billed Party (including us) to pay "extended payment charges" at 300% of the Subparagraph 7.8 prime-rate reference, running without time limit until payment; a treble rate is a penalty payable by us rather than a compensatory funding cost. Subparagraph 23.2 compounds this by forfeiting all "payment or credit for the reclaimed capacity" and any "reimbursement of any amounts it had paid", again a penalty borne by us rather than compensation for actual loss. The fallback (early-termination fee capped at 3 months' fees) is inapplicable because no early-termination fee exists, so we pursue the preferred position: strike the 300% multiplier so late payments accrue at the ordinary Subparagraph 7.8 rate, and convert 23.2's forfeiture into a pro-rata credit/reimbursement for capacity not received. Noted but not separately flagged: Paragraph 7.8 financial charges and the no-credit rule on voluntary termination (p0233) are not Customer-payable penalties.

ops.oldText: three hundred percent (300%) of the rate described in Subparagraph 7.8
the defaulting Party shall not be entitled to any payment or credit for the reclaimed capacity
ops.newText: the defaulting Party shall be entitled to a pro-rata credit for the reclaimed capacity

ops.oldText: The defaulting Party is not entitled to any reimbursement of any amounts it had paid under this Agreement.
ops.newText: The defaulting Party is entitled to a pro-rata reimbursement of amounts it had paid under this Agreement for capacity not received.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We removed the 300% multiplier so late payments accrue at the compensatory Subparagraph 7.8 rate, and in 23.2 replaced the forfeiture of paid amounts and reclaimed capacity with a pro-rata credit/reimbursement, so no penalty is payable by us. Our position is that no liquidated damages or penalties be payable by us.
proposal.summary: Strike the 300% late-payment multiplier and convert 23.2's forfeiture on reclamation into a pro-rata credit and reimbursement.

mappings.element: No liquidated damages payable by Customer.
